data.title: General Mills Named to 3BL’s 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens List for 18th Consecutive Year
data.description: General Mills of Minneapolis has been recognized on 3BL's 2026 100 Best Corporate Citizens list, securing the No. 5 spot in the Consumer Staples category for an impressive 18th consecutive year. The company showed significant improvement in various areas, with notable progress seen in Environment, Stakeholders and Society, Human Rights, and Governance. They made strides by expanding regenerative agriculture practices to over 800,000 acres and cutting greenhouse gas emissions throughout their value chain.

data.title: Expensify Becomes One of the First Expense Management Tools Available in Claude for Small Business
data.description: In San Francisco, Expensify, Inc. revealed a new integration with Anthropic, allowing Expensify to become a connector in the Claude for Small Business plugin. This move makes Expensify one of the initial expense management tools to join the plugin. Expensify, traded on Nasdaq as EXFY, offers solutions for expense, travel, and corporate card management. The integration aims to streamline processes for business owners. Additionally, Expensify is set to conduct a webinar on this new connector during the upcoming fall season. This webinar forms part of the Claude for Small Business partner webinar series, offering insights into the latest integration.

data.title: Security Federal Corporation Announces Special Dividend
data.description: Aiken, South Carolina - On September 15, 2026, Security Federal Corporation, the parent company of Security Federal Bank, revealed a special cash dividend of $0.18 per share. This dividend is scheduled to be distributed on October 15, 2026, to shareholders who are recorded as such by September 30, 2026.

data.title: Institutions focus on rehypothecation risks of wrapped BTC products like cirBTC due to reserve transparency concerns.
data.description: The credibility of Wrapped Bitcoin (BTC) products such as cirBTC is being questioned over concerns regarding rehypothecation risks and transparency of reserves. Institutions are paying close attention to segregated collateral to ensure the safety of their investments. Find out more about why this is a critical issue worth exploring further.

data.title: Ava Labs names Charley Cooper as president, with John Wu now a senior advisor, and Lydia Chiu as CFO, emphasizing operational expansion in leadership changes.
data.description: Ava Labs has recently named Charley Cooper as their new president, while John Wu is stepping into the role of senior advisor. Additionally, Lydia Chiu has been appointed as the chief financial officer. This move highlights the company's emphasis on operational expansion.

data.title: Foot Levelers Secures Patent for Nexi® Custom Pillow Bringing Personalized Support to Sleep
data.description: A company in Roanoke, Virginia has patented the Nexi® Custom Pillow, which is a personalized sleep technology aimed at enhancing alignment and reducing discomfort, particularly related to tech neck. This specialized pillow is designed by Foot Levelers and is intended to provide targeted support for individuals experiencing issues related to alignment and discomfort, particularly from prolonged use of technology.

data.title: Newell Brands Opens Atlanta Design Center to Accelerate Brand Building Through Consumer-Led Design and Innovation
data.description: Newell Brands has unveiled its new Atlanta Design Center, a specialized facility dedicated to design excellence and consumer-driven innovation. The center aims to foster creativity and forward-thinking solutions for the company. This state-of-the-art hub will house a talented team of designers and innovators, embodying Newell's commitment to cutting-edge design and product development. The center marks a significant investment in advancing the company's design capabilities and will serve as a focal point for innovation.

data.title: TRUEWERK Appoints Dane Howell as Senior Vice President of B2B and Pamela Jabalera as Vice President of Planning and Inventory Management
data.description: In Denver, TRUEWERK, a brand specializing in performance workwear for modern trades professionals, has added two new leaders to its team. Dane Howell joins as Senior VP of Business to Business Sales, while Pamela Jabalera takes on the role of VP of Planning and Inventory Management. These additions are part of TRUEWERK's efforts to grow its operations and broaden market presence, in line with its goal of creating the most advanced workwear globally.

data.title: Boston Personal Injury Firm Turns a Six-Month-Stalled Case Into a 48-Hour Demand, Adds 50 More Cases a Month
data.description: In Boston, a previously stagnant legal case lingered for six months before being transferred to EvenUp's Pre-Lit as a Service (PLAAS™) program. With the help of this service, the case was efficiently processed and turned into a completed demand within just 48 hours. Larry Nussbaum, a Partner at Altman Nussbaum Shunnarah Trial Attorneys in Massachusetts, expressed his amazement at the quick resolution. PLAAS™ connects firms with dedicated case managers from EvenUp who oversee pre-litigation cases from start to finish, utilizing EvenUp's AI technology to monitor client progress and identify any gaps in information.

data.title: EDF reveals final results of tender offer for series of hybrid notes.
data.description: In recent data released, it has been reported that the unemployment rate has decreased to 4.3% in the last month, showcasing a significant improvement in job market conditions. The number of new job openings has also risen by 15% compared to the previous quarter, reaching a total of 6.2 million vacancies. Additionally, the average hourly wage has seen a growth of 3.2% year-over-year, demonstrating positive economic indicators. These numbers indicate a promising outlook for employment and economic growth in the near future.

data.title: BTC drops to $75.6K low amid rising global bond rates and market jitters before Senate vote, impacting risk assets.
data.description: The value of Bitcoin decreased due to market unease before the Senate vote on the CLARITY Act, while rising bond yields negatively impacted various risk assets.

data.title: TPG to Make Significant Investment in Tablet Command
data.description: TPG, a global alternative asset management firm, revealed that The Rise Funds, its impact investing strategy, has finalized an agreement to invest heavily in Tablet Command. The company, established in 2011 by Andy Bozzo and William Pigeon, offers incident management and response software for fire departments and emergency response agencies. This move signifies a significant step in TPG's multi-sector impact investing approach.

data.title: Lynn University Has Been Designated an Apple Distinguished School
data.description: Lynn University in Boca Raton, Florida, has recently received recognition as an Apple Distinguished School for the program term spanning from September 2026 to December 2029. The institution was chosen for its dedication to ongoing innovation in education and leveraging Apple technology to enhance teaching and learning experiences. By demonstrating a commitment to utilizing Apple products to foster creativity and engagement among students, Lynn University joins a select group of educational institutions awarded this distinction. This acknowledgment reflects the university's enduring partnership with Apple and its shared mission to provide all Lynn students with access to cutting-edge technology for academic success.

data.title: iFIT Makes Fast Company’s Eighth Annual List of the Best Workplaces for Innovators in Emerging Enterprise: 201-999 Employees Category
data.description: A company based in Park City, Utah was recently included in Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators list. iFIT Inc., a global leader in interactive fitness technology and connected content, was recognized in the Emerging Enterprise category for businesses with 201-999 employees. The company earned this distinction due to its successful expansion into connected Pilates. According to the company, innovation at iFIT is not attributed to a single team or breakthrough, but rather a collective effort involving multiple teams and continuous improvement initiatives.

data.title: Kalshi Partners with US Hispanic Chamber of Commerce and Greater Washington Hispanic Chamber to Bring Next-Gen Risk Management to Latino-Owned Business
data.description: Kalshi, a modern financial exchange, has unveiled a collaboration with the United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC) and the Greater Washington Hispanic Chamber of Commerce. This partnership aims to provide risk management tools and educational resources to Hispanic-owned businesses nationwide. The USHCC is the largest small business advocacy group in America, representing 260 local chambers as well as numerous business associations and corporations. This initiative will reach a significant number of Hispanic-owned businesses, offering them valuable support and guidance.

data.title: Mattel and BBC Studios Expand the World of Bluey Through Multi-Brand Global Licensing Partnership
data.description: Mattel, Inc., known for its iconic brand portfolio, and BBC Studios have entered a multi-year global licensing deal to introduce Bluey to five of Mattel's franchises. This partnership will feature products from Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, Polly Pocket, and UNO. Fans worldwide can look forward to experiencing the popular series through these products starting this fall. This collaboration aims to celebrate the beloved animated show and brings it to a wider audience through recognizable brands.
